'''Jaq Orin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was imprisoned in [[Camp Vigil]], a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], in [[3642 BBY]]. He was only in cell 665 for less than a day when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Akaavi Spar]] and a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] freed the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and destroyed the facility.
